examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubb'ārāme migāramātupāsāde. tena kho pana samayena bhagavā sāy'anhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito bahidvārakoṭṭhake nisinno hoti.
atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ bāhāyaṃ gahetvā bahidvārakoṭṭhakā nikkhāmetvā sūcighaṭikaṃ datvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami
hīnaṃ nāma kammaṃ, koṭṭhakakammaṃ, pupphachaḍḍakakammaṃ, tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu oññātaṃ avaññātaṃ hīḷitaṃ paribhūtaṃ acittīkataṃ, etaṃ hīnaṃ nāma kammaṃ.

23005.commentary: (MNa) koṭṭham'anupaviṭṭho'ti kucchiṃ pavisitvā antānaṃ anto anupaviṭṭho, pakkāsayaṭṭhāne nisinno.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena māro pāpimā āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa kucchigato hoti koṭṭham'anupaviṭṭho. atha kho āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa etadahosi, kiṃ nu kho me kucchi garugaro viya mās'ācitaṃ maññe'ti.

yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ vāyo vāyogataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, uddhaṅ'gamā vātā, adhogamā vātā, kucchisayā vātā, koṭṭhasayā vātā, aṅgam'aṅg'ānusārino vātā, assāso passāso… ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā vāyodhātu.
paṭicchannaṃ nāma āsanaṃ kuṭṭena vā kavāṭena vā kilañjena vā sāṇipākārena vā rukkhena vā thambhena vā koṭṭhaḷiyā vā yena kenaci paṭicchannaṃ hoti.

23009.commentary: (DNa) paripuṇṇakosakoṭṭh'āgāro'ti koso vuccati bhaṇḍ'āgāraṃ, nidahitvā ṭhapitena dhanena paripuṇṇakoso, dhaññena paripuṇṇakoṭṭh'āgāro cā'ti attho. athavā catubbidho koso, hatthī, assā, rathā, pattī'ti. koṭṭh'āgāraṃ tividhaṃ, dhanakoṭṭh'āgāraṃ, vatthakoṭṭh'āgāraṃ, dhaññakoṭṭh'āgāran'ti, taṃ sabbam'pi paripuṇṇam'assā'ti paripuṇṇakosakoṭṭh'āgāro. (JAa) koṭṭhāgārānī'ti suvaṇṇa-rajata-maṇi-mutt'ādi-ratana-koṭṭh'āgārāni c'eva dussakoṭṭh'āgārāni ca dhaññakoṭṭh'āgārāni ca.

examples.text: hitvā gāmasahassāni, paripuṇṇāni soḷasa, koṭṭh'āgārāni phītāni, sannidhiṃ dāni kubbasi.

saddho vā duggahitenā'ti, yo hi ñāṇavirahitāya saddhāya atisaddho hoti muddhappasanno, so'pi, buddho nāma sabbalok'uttaro, sabbe tassa kes'ādayo bāttiṃsa koṭṭhāsā lok'uttarā'y'evā'ti-ādinā nayena duggahitaṃ gaṇhitvā tathāgataṃ abbhācikkhati.

23012.synonym: kaṇḍa, pada, padesa, bhāga, vidhā, sambhāra

23014.meaning1: part of being; portion of existence

examples.text: yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ vāyo vāyogataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, uddhaṅ'gamā vātā, adhogamā vātā, kucchisayā vātā, koṭṭh'āsayā vātā, aṅgam'aṅg'ānusārino vātā, assāso passāso… ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā vāyodhātu.

23017.meaning1: with internal organs; having internal parts
23017.construction:
koṭṭha + āsaya > āsa + vant
koṭṭhāsa + vant

23018.meaning1: with a store-room; having a granary

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kurūsu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena thullakoṭṭhikaṃ nāma kurūnaṃ nigamo tadavasari.

23019.meaningLit: discourse with Koṭṭhita on not oneself

23020.meaningLit: discourse with Koṭṭhita in the impermanent

23021.meaningLit: discourse with Koṭṭhita on the uncomfortable

23025.meaningLit: discourse with Koṭṭhita on the impersonal

23026.meaningLit: discourse with Koṭṭhita in the impermanent

examples.text: anekehi sambhārehi samāraddhā vadati, seyyath'idaṃ, doṇiñ'ca paṭicca cammañ'ca paṭicca daṇḍañ'ca paṭicca upadhāraṇe ca paṭicca tantiyo ca paṭicca koṇañ'ca paṭicca purisassa ca tajjaṃ vāyāmaṃ paṭicca ev'āyaṃ, bhante, vīṇā nāma anekasambhārā mahāsambhārā.

23031.synonym: kalevara, deha, mata, matasarīra, sarīra, sarīraka
23031.commentary: (DNa) kaṭasīsu khittāni ca koṇapānī'ti susānesu chaḍḍitakuṇapāni ca khāditvā.

examples.text: bhutvāna bheke khalamūsikāyo, kaṭasīsu khittāni ca koṇapāni, mahāvane suññavane vivaḍḍho, amaññi kotthu migarāj'āham'asmi.

23032.commentary: (BVa) kakusandhassa pana bhagavato aparabhāge tassa sāsane ca antarahite sattesu tiṃsavassasahass'āyukesu jātesu parahitakoṇāgamano koṇāgamano nāma satthā loke udapādi. atha vā kanakāgamanato koṇāgamano nāma satthā loke udapādi. tattha ka-kārassa koādesaṃ katvā na-kārassa ṇādesaṃ katvā ekassa ka-kārassa lopaṃ katvā niruttinayena kanakassa kanak'ādiābharaṇassa āgamanaṃ pavassanaṃ yassa bhagavato uppannakāle so koṇāgamano nāma.

examples.text: koṇāgamano, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho brāhmaṇo jātiyā ahosi, brāhmaṇakule udapādi.
kakusandhassa aparena, sambuddho dvipad'uttamo, koṇāgamano nāma jino, lokajeṭṭho nar'āsabho.

23035.meaning1: name of a monk; seniormost of the five ascetics; first monastic disciple of the Buddha
23035.commentary: (SNa) aññāsikoṇḍañño'ti paṭhamaṃ dhammassa aññātattā evaṃ gahitanāmo thero.

examples.text: aññāsi vata, bho, koṇḍañño, aññāsi vata, bho, koṇḍañño'ti! iti h'idaṃ āyasmato koṇḍaññassa aññāsikoṇḍañño tv'eva nāmaṃ ahosī'ti.

sikhī, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho koṇḍañño gottena ahosi. vessabhū, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho koṇḍañño gottena ahosi. kakusandho, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kassapo gottena ahosi.

23040.notes: MW fr. kutas and hala, 'calling out' ?

examples.text: evaṃ vutte purimāni, bhante, divasāni purimatarāni, nānātitthiyānaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ kotūhalasālāya sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ abhisaññānirodhe kathā udapādi, kathaṃ nu kho, bho, abhisaññānirodho hotī'ti?

23041.meaning2: what is auspicious and portentous; special ceremonies and auspicious rites
23041.commentary: (MNa) vatakotūhalamaṅgalānī'ti vatasamādānāni ca diṭṭhikutūhalāni ca diṭṭhasutamutamaṅgalāni ca.

examples.text: api nu tumhe, bhikkhave, evaṃ jānantā evaṃ passantā yāni tāni puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ vata kotūhalamaṅgalāni tāni sārato paccāgaccheyyāthā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

23042.meaning1: engaging in noisy debates and auspicious ceremonies
23042.meaning2: trusting in omens and portents; setting store by ceremonies and auspicious rites; superstitious
23042.commentary: (ANa) kotūhalamaṅgaliko'ti iminā idaṃ bhavissatī'ti evaṃ pavattattā kotūhalasaṅkhātena diṭṭhasutamutamaṅgalena samannāgato.

examples.text: katamehi pañcahi? assaddho hoti, dussīlo hoti, kotūhalamaṅgaliko hoti, maṅgalaṃ pacceti no kammaṃ, ito ca bahiddhā dakkhiṇeyyaṃ gavesati, tattha ca pubbakāraṃ karoti. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato upāsako upāsakacaṇḍālo ca hoti upāsakamalañ'ca upāsakapatikuṭṭho ca.

23043.commentary: (DNa) kotūhalasālāyan'ti kotūhalasālā nāma paccekasālā n'atthi. yattha pana nānātitthiyā samaṇabrāhmaṇā nānāvidhaṃ kathaṃ pavattenti, sā bahūnaṃ, ayaṃ kiṃ vadati, ayaṃ kiṃ vadatī'ti kotūhal'uppattiṭṭhānato kotūhalasālā'ti vuccati. (DNt) kutūhalam'ettha atthī'ti kotūhalā, sā eva sālā'ti kotūhalasālā, ten'āha kotūhal'uppattiṭṭhānato'ti.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte purimāni, bhante, divasāni purimatarāni, nānātitthiyānaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ kotūhalasālāya sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ abhisaññānirodhe kathā udapādi, kathaṃ nu kho, bho, abhisaññānirodho hotī'ti?
paṭicchannaṃ nāma āsanaṃ kuṭṭena vā kavāṭena vā kilañjena vā sāṇipākārena vā rukkhena vā thambhena vā kotthaḷiyā vā yena kenaci paṭicchannaṃ hoti.
sīho'ti attānaṃ samekkhiyāna, amaññi kotthu migarāj'āham'asmi, tath'evaso siṅgālakaṃ anadi, ke ca chave siṅgāle ke pana sīhanāde'ti.
seyyathā'pi nāma kotthu nadītīre macche maggayamāno jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati apajjhāyati.

23046.commentary: (SNa) chavo sigālo'ti lāmako kālasigālo. kotthuko'ti tass'eva vevacanaṃ. (SNt) kotthuko'ti khuddakakotthu.

examples.text: sah'ācaritena chavo sigālo, na kotthuko sīhasamo kadāci, naggo musāvādī gaṇassa satthā, saṅkassar'ācāro na sataṃ sarikkho'ti.

atha kho milindo rājā khaggaparivārito viya gajo, garuḷaparivārito viya nāgo, ajagaraparivārito viya kotthuko, mahiṃsaparivuto viya accho, nāg'ānubaddho viya maṇḍūko, saddūl'ānubaddho viya migo, ahituṇḍikasamāgato viya pannago, majjārasamāgato viya undūro, bhūtavejjasamāgato viya pisāco… bhīto…
āvudhaṃ nāma cāpo kodaṇḍo.
āvudhapāṇissā'ti ettha kiñ'c'āpi vuttaṃ, āvudhaṃ nāma cāpo kodaṇḍo'ti, atha kho sabbā'pi dhanuvikati saddhiṃ saravikatiyā āvudhan'ti veditabbaṃ.

23048.commentary: (MNa) tattha kujjhanalakkhaṇo kodho, caṇḍikkalakkhaṇo vā, āghātakaraṇaraso, dussanapaccupaṭṭhāno. (ANa) paresu kujjhanalakkhaṇo kodho.

examples.text: kodhaṃ jhatvā sukhaṃ seti, kodhaṃ jhatvā na socati, kodhassa visamūlassa, madhur'aggassa devate, vadhaṃ ariyā pasaṃsanti, tañ'hi jhatvā na socatī'ti.
yassa kassaci, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno abhijjhālussa abhijjhā appahīnā hoti, byāpannacittassa byāpādo appahīno hoti, kodhanassa kodho appahīno hoti
ko'dha santusito loke, kassa no santi iñjitā, ko ubh'antam'abhiññāya, majjhe mantā na lippati, kaṃ brūsi mahāpuriso'ti, ko idha sibbinim'accagā.
pakkamissañ'ca nāḷāto, ko'dha nāḷāya vacchati, bandhantī itthirūpena, samaṇe dhammajīvino.

23050.meaning1: valuing anger; giving weight to rage
23050.commentary: (ANa) kodhagaru na saddhammagarū'ti kodhaṃ gāravena garuṃ katvā gaṇhāti, na saddhammaṃ, saddhammaṃ pana agāravena lāmakaṃ katvā gaṇhāti.

examples.text: katame cattāro? kodhagaru na saddhammagaru, makkhagaru na saddhammagaru, lābhagaru na saddhammagaru, sakkāragaru na saddhammagaru. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.

23051.meaning1: fact of valuing anger; fact of giving weight to rage

examples.text: katame cattāro? kodhagarutā na saddhammagarutā, makkhagarutā na saddhammagarutā, lābhagarutā na saddhammagarutā, sakkāragarutā na saddhammagarutā. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro asaddhammā.
kodhano dubbaṇṇo hoti, atho dukkham'pi seti so, atho atthaṃ gahetvāna, anatthaṃ adhipajjati.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo, appam'pi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti.

23058.meaning1: characterised by anger; known for anger; with angry nature
23058.commentary: (SNPa) dhajo'va rathassa, dhūmo'va aggino, kodho paññāṇam'assā'ti kodhapaññāṇo.

examples.text: niddāsīlī sabhāsīlī, anuṭṭhātā ca yo naro, alaso kodhapaññāṇo, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.

23061.meaning1: anger-eating; feeding on wrath; (comm) name of a daemon
23061.commentary: (SNa) kodhabhakkho'ti sakkena gahitanāmam'ev'etaṃ. so pana eko rūp'āvacarabrahmā, sakko kira khantibalena samannāgato'ti sutvā vīmaṃsan'atthaṃ āgato.

examples.text: yathā yathā kho, mārisa, devā ujjhāyanti khiyyanti vipācenti, tathā tathā so yakkho abhirūpataro c'eva hoti dassanīyataro ca pāsādikataro cā'ti. so hi nūna, mārisa, kodhabhakkho yakkho bhavissatī'ti.

23062.meaning1: valuing anger and denigrating others; giving weight to rage and depreciating others
23062.commentary: (NPa) kodhamakkhagarū'ti kujjhanalakkhaṇaṃ kodhaṃ, paraguṇamakkhanalakkhaṇaṃ makkhañ'ca garuṃ katvā uddhaṃ katvā ukkhipitvā caranto.

examples.text: kodhamakkhagarū bhikkhū, lābhasakkāragāravā, na te dhamme virūhanti, sammāsambuddhadesite.

23064.meaning1: anger and pride; temper and superiority

23065.meaning1: for removing anger, conceit and denigration
23065.constructionSummary: kodha + māna + makkha + vinaya + attha + aṃ
23065.construction:
kodha + māna + makkha + vinaya + attha + aṃ
kodhamānamakkhavinayattha + aṃ

examples.text: kiṃ nu kujjhasi mā kujjhi, akkodho tissa te varaṃ, kodha-māna-makkha-vinay'atthañ'hi, tissa brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti.

23066.meaning1: intoxicated with anger; drunk with rage
23066.meaning2: exhilarated with the intoxication of anger
23066.meaningLit: intoxicated with the intoxicant of anger

examples.text: kodhasammadasammatto, āyasakyaṃ nigacchati, ñātimittā suhajjā ca, parivajjanti kodhanaṃ.

23067.meaning1: close to anger; bordering on rage

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu kodhano hoti kodhasāmantā vācaṃ nicchāretā. yam'p'āvuso, bhikkhu kodhano hoti kodhasāmantā vācaṃ nicchāretā, ayam'pi dhammo dovacassakaraṇo.
pharusavāco hoti. yā sā vācā aṇḍakā kakkasā parakaṭukā par'ābhisajjanī kodhasāmantā asamādhisaṃvattanikā, tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti

23071.meaning1: removal of wrath; dispelling of anger

examples.text: katame dve? kodhavinayo ca upanāhavinayo ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve dhammā'ti.

23072.meaning1: due to anger; because of rage

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu kodhano hoti kodhahetu upanāhī. yam'p'āvuso, bhikkhu kodhano hoti kodhahetu upanāhī, ayam'pi dhammo dovacassakaraṇo.

23073.meaning2: having the manifestation of immediately following anger

23074.meaning1: who has overcome anger; who has mastered one's temper

examples.text: maccheravinaye yuttaṃ, saccaṃ kodh'ābhibhuṃ naraṃ, taṃ ve devā tāvatiṃsā, āhu sappuriso itī'ti.

23075.meaning1: overcome by anger; overpowered by rage

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu kodhano hoti kodh'ābhibhūto. yam'p'āvuso, bhikkhu kodhano hoti kodh'ābhibhūto, ayam'pi dhammo dovacassakaraṇo.

23077.meaning1: anger and irritation; rage and being upset
23077.commentary: (MNa) tattha balavappatto kodho'va kodh'ūpāyāso. pajaha kodh'ūpāyāsan'ti ettha paṭisaṅkhānappahānaṃ kathitaṃ.

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ūmibhayassa bhīto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvatto. ūmibhayan'ti kho, bhikkhave, kodh'ūpāyāsassa-etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ūmibhayaṃ.
uddhumāyikā'ti kho, bhikkhu, kodh'ūpāyāsass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. ukkhipa uddhumāyikaṃ, pajaha kodh'ūpāyāsaṃ, abhikkhaṇa, sumedha, satthaṃ ādāyā'ti ayam'etassa attho.

23078.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of kodhūpāyāsapaccaya
23078.meaning1: dependent on anger and irritation; due to rage and being upset

examples.text: ahañ'c'eva kho pana kodh'ūpāyāsī assaṃ, attā'pi maṃ upavadeyya kodh'ūpāyāsapaccayā, anuviccā'pi maṃ viññū garaheyyuṃ kodh'ūpāyāsapaccayā, kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā kodh'ūpāyāsapaccayā.

23079.meaning1: who is angry and irritable; who is full of rage and upset

examples.text: ahañ'c'eva kho pana kodh'ūpāyāsī assaṃ, attā'pi maṃ upavadeyya kodh'ūpāyāsapaccayā, anuviccā'pi maṃ viññū garaheyyuṃ kodh'ūpāyāsapaccayā, kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā kodh'ūpāyāsapaccayā.

23081.commentary: (MNa) ko nāmo āyasmā'ti na thero tassa nāmaṃ na jānāti. jānanto'y'eva pana sammodituṃ labhissāmī'ti pucchi

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ puṇṇaṃ mantāṇiputtaṃ etadavoca, konāmo āyasmā, kathañ'ca pan'āyasmantaṃ sabrahmacārī jānantī'ti? puṇṇo'ti kho me, āvuso, nāmaṃ, mantāṇiputto'ti ca pana maṃ sabrahmacārī jānantī'ti.
api hi me, bhante, imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ sutvā lomāni haṭṭhāni. konāmo ayaṃ, bhante, dhammapariyāyo'ti? tasmā't'iha tvaṃ, nāgasamāla, imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ lomahaṃsanapariyāyo tv'eva naṃ dhārehī'ti.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo, appam'pi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti.
kiṃ nu kho me ayyā santaṃ'y'eva nu kho ajjhattaṃ kopaṃ na pātukaroti udāhu asantaṃ udāhu mayham'ev'ete kamm'antā susaṃvihitā yena me ayyā santaṃ'y'eva ajjhattaṃ kopaṃ na pātukaroti, no asantaṃ?

23085.commentary: (SNPa) yass'antarato na santi kopā'ti tatiyamaggena samūhatattā yassa citte na santi kopā'ti attho.

examples.text: yass'antarato na santi kopā, itibhav'ābhavatañ'ca vītivatto, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.

23086.meaning2: tending to make angry; (that) which disturbs

23087.commentary: (NIDD1a) kopanīye na kuppatī'ti kodhanīyasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ na calati.

examples.text: katamehi pañcahi? rajanīye rajjati, dusanīye dussati, mohanīye muyhati, kopanīye kuppati, madanīye majjati, imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca.
cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā rajanīye na rajjati, dussanīye na dussati, mohanīye na muyhati, kopanīye na kuppati, madanīye na majjati, kilesanīye na kilissati.

23089.meaning1: angry; wrathful; with an angry heart

examples.text: accayaṃ desayantīnaṃ, yo ce na paṭigaṇhati, kop'antaro dosagaru, sa veraṃ paṭimuñcatī'ti.

23090.meaning2: agitates; disturbs; provokes; makes invalid; violates

23092.meaning2: caused to make angry, caused to disturb, caused to shake, caused to trespass a law

examples.text: sabbattha te citta vaco kataṃ mayā, bahūsu jātīsu na me'si kopito, ajjhattasambhavo kataññutāya te, dukkhe ciraṃ saṃsaritaṃ tayā kate.
